name: Arjun chhaal
actions: Traditionally used as a heart tonic (hridya)
traditionalUses: Heart health (traditional; always alongside a cardiologist)
kitchenUse: Bark powder boiled in milk and water (ksheerapaka), only with a doctor’s knowledge for heart conditions.

typicalUse.note: Never a replacement for heart medicine.

cautions.note: Heart conditions need a cardiologist. Do not start without telling them.

interactions.effect: May interact with heart medicines; check with a cardiologist.
May add to the effect of blood thinners.

evidence.summary: Small human studies in heart conditions, mostly short and of limited quality.

sources.title: The Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India, Part I
